source.author: verg
source.text: Sic placida populos in pace regebat, deterior donec paulatim ac decolor aetas et belli rabies et amor successit habendi.
source.text_original: Sic placida populos in pace regebat, / deterior donec paulatim ac decolor aetas / et belli rabies et amor successit habendi.
source.text_english: Thus he ruled the peoples in peaceful tranquility, until by degrees a worse and more corrupt age came on, and the fury of war, and the lust for possession.

reuse.author: lact
reuse.text: et alio loco: aurea quae perhibent illo sub rege fuere saecula: sic placida populos in pace regebat .
reuse.text_original: et alio loco: aurea quae perhibent illo sub rege fuere saecula: sic placida populos in pace regebat .
reuse.text_english: and in another place: the ages that they speak of as golden were under that king; thus he ruled the peoples in tranquil peace.
